name: The Lounge
description: The Lounge is a modern, open-source, web-based IRC (Internet Relay Chat) client that offers persistent connectivity, allowing users to remain connected to IRC servers even while offline, and provides a responsive interface compatible with desktops, smartphones, and tablets.
short_desc: Modern web IRC client designed for self-hosting
author: The Lounge Team

form_fields.label: Container User (UID:GID)
form_fields.hint: Process user and group ID (UID:GID). Keep 1000:1000 unless custom host permissions are required.
form_fields.pattern_error: Must be a numeric UID:GID (e.g. 1000:1000) or numeric UID (e.g. 1000)
